changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Image Captioning' as it's not actually evaluated in the paper (only mentioned in dataset description). Added CIFAR-100 and Conceptual 12M as they are used for evaluation. Normalized dataset names and output description.
Simplified Recall@1, @5, @10 to just 'Recall' following normalization rules. Kept 'Accuracy' and 'Detection Rate' as they are used metrics.
No LLM-based evaluation is used in this paper. The paper focuses on machine unlearning evaluation using automatic metrics and attention/embedding visualizations.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. All evaluations are based on automatic metrics and visual analysis.

overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on machine unlearning for multimodal models (CLIP) and evaluates through downstream tasks including text-to-image generation. While NLG is present (image generation), it's not the main focus. The extraction was mostly accurate but needed normalization and removal of non-evaluated tasks.
